title: How to Improve Your Salon Rebooking Rate: 8 Ways That Work

facts.fact: The page's salon rebooking rate formula is: clients who rebooked before leaving divided by total clients served, multiplied by 100.
facts.quote: Rebooking rate = (number of clients who rebooked before leaving ÷ total clients served) × 100

facts.fact: The page gives an example in which 180 of 400 clients rebooked, yielding a rebooking rate of 45%.
facts.quote: For example, if 180 out of 400 clients rebooked, your rate is 45%.

facts.fact: The page says some salons also count bookings made a day or two after the visit, and that salons should stick to one counting rule.
facts.quote: Some salons also count bookings made a day or two later. That's fine, just stick to one rule.

facts.fact: The page states that unnamed published industry benchmarks put the average salon rebooking rate between 40% and 55%.
facts.quote: Published industry benchmarks put the average somewhere between 40% and 55%, plenty of owners work towards 60%, and the strongest salons pass 70%.

facts.fact: The page says many owners work towards a 60% rebooking rate and the strongest salons pass 70%, citing unnamed industry benchmarks.
facts.quote: plenty of owners work towards 60%, and the strongest salons pass 70%.

facts.fact: The page recommends gel or acrylic nail clients return every 2 to 3 weeks.
facts.quote: Gel or acrylic nails: every 2 to 3 weeks

facts.fact: The page recommends fades and short men's cuts be rebooked every 3 to 4 weeks.
facts.quote: Fades and short men’s cuts: every 3 to 4 weeks

facts.fact: The page recommends root colour be rebooked every 4 to 6 weeks.
The page recommends facial clients return about once a month.
The page recommends sending at least one appointment reminder a couple of days before the appointment.
facts.quote: at least a single one a couple of days before

facts.fact: The page recommends contacting clients who have not rebooked a few days before their appointment slot.
facts.quote: contact them a few days before their appointment slot

facts.fact: Salonist's pricing banner states the plan now offers unlimited staff with no staff limits.
facts.quote: Unlimited staff. No staff limits. Get more features for less.
